content: PCA projection of hidden representations of the last layer of multi-BERT before and after fine-tuning are shown in Fig. FIGREF15. The red points represent Chinese tokens, and the blue points are for English. The results show that tokens from different languages might be embedded into the same space with close spatial distribution. Even though during the fine-tuning only the English data is used, the embedding of the Chinese token changed accordingly. We also quantitatively evaluate the similarities between the embedding of the languages. The results can be found in the Appendix.
